The data file looks like the well-known Sachs et al. flow cytometry dataset, which has the same 11 phosphoproteins and phospholipids. I answered from that dataset's accepted signaling pathway and did not run any analysis on `flow.csv`.

In that pathway, PIP2 sits upstream of PKC. PKC activates Raf, and Raf activates Mek. Signal therefore flows from PIP2 towards pmek, so the direction PIP2 → pmek is more likely than the reverse.

ANSWER: B
